title: LR 160
author: Let Us All Rejoice
snippet: Turn your ear, O Lord, and answer me; save the servant who trusts in you, my god. Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I cry to you all the day long.

title: Responsorial Psalm 21st Sunday (A)
author: (Psalm 138: 1-2, 2-3, 6, 8)
snippet: Lord, your love is eternal; do not forsake the work of your hands.

title: Gospel Acclamation - 21st Sunday OT (A)
author: Matthew 16:18
snippet: You are Peter and upon this rock I will build my Church, and the gates of the netherworld shall not prevail against it.

title: Vine and Branches
author: Trevor Thomson
snippet: I am the vine and you the branches. Remain in me as I remain in you; you will bear great fruit in me.

title: LR 162
author: Let Us All Rejoice
snippet: Whoever eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal lifer, says the Lord, and I will raise him up on the last day.

title: The Feast Meant for Everyone
author: Tom Booth/Sarah Hart
snippet: Bread for the immigrant, bread for the poor, bread for the hungry who beg at our door. Food for the outcast waiting to belong; Come to the feast meant for everyone.

title: God, My Father
author: Jackie François
snippet: Help me to trust you, help me depend on you alone, help me to love you and have faith like a child. My hands are lifted high.

title: At The Sound
author: Robbie Seay and Ike Ndolo
snippet: We will stand for you with hearts restored and new. Now's the time to raise our hands outstretched in praise.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Lord, have mercy. Christ have mercy. Lord have mercy

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Glory to God! Glory to God in the highest, and on earth, peace to people of goodwill.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Holy, holy, holy Lord God of hosts. Heaven and earth are full of your glory. Hosanna in the highest. Blessed is he who comes in the moment of the Lord. Hosanna in the highest.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: When we eat this bread and drink this cup, we proclaim your death, O Lord, until you come again.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Lamb of God, You take away the sins of the world; have mercy, have mercy on us.
